title: Classical-to-DFT multi-fidelity approach for developing machine learning potentials of aqueous systems
title_zh: 用于开发水系统机器学习潜力的经典到 DFT 多保真方法
summary: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）以传统电子结构计算成本的一小部分提供近乎从头算的精度，但其可靠性主要取决于训练数据的质量和多样性。在这里，我们提出了一种用于高效数据集生成的经典到密度泛函理论 (DFT) 多保真工作流程，其中长经典分子动力学轨迹辅以选择性 DFT 优化配置来训练神经网络潜力。我们在四个系统上演示了这种方法：散装水、空气-水界面处的水、散装水中的 CaSO 4 和界面处的 CaSO 4 。
abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer near– ab initio accuracy at a fraction of the cost of conventional electronic structure calculations, but their reliability depends critically on the quality and diversity of training data. Here, we present a classical-to-density functional theory (DFT) multi-fidelity workflow for efficient dataset generation, in which long classical molecular dynamics trajectories are supplemented with selectively DFT-optimized configurations to train neural network potentials. We demonstrate this approach on four systems: bulk water, water at the air–water interface, CaSO 4 in bulk water, and CaSO 4 at the interface. In all cases, the trained models faithfully reproduce reference DFT properties, validating the workflow across both simple and chemically complex environments. We further probe the extrapolation capabilities of the models, showing that bulk-trained networks can generalize to different temperatures, pressures, and interfacial geometries when datasets include targeted augmented configurations. This multi-fidelity strategy thus enables accurate and transferable MLIPs for complex solvated and interfacial systems, bridging the gap between computational efficiency and first-principles accuracy.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Machine-learning charge density for electronic materials and devices simulation
title_zh: 用于电子材料和器件模拟的机器学习电荷密度
summary: 我们提出了一种机器学习 (ML) 电荷密度模型 DeltaChargeNet，它与全势紧束缚松饼轨道 (FP-TB-MTO) 方法集成，用于材料和器件的电子结构和量子输运模拟。 ML 模型以低线性缩放成本预测原子结构的电子密度，而 FP-TB-MTO 提供系统哈密顿量的精确紧束缚表示。为了实现具有界面和无序的复杂设备的高保真机器学习密度，我们训练了一个等变图卷积网络来预测 Δρ（DFT 和原子叠加密度之间的差异），在非均匀系统所需的电荷中性约束下。
abstract: arXiv:2611.17627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a machine-learning (ML) charge density model, DeltaChargeNet, integrated with the full-potential tight-binding muffin-tin orbital (FP-TB-MTO) method for electronic structure and quantum transport simulations of materials and devices. The ML model predicts electron density from atomic structures with low linear-scaling cost, while FP-TB-MTO provides an accurate tight-binding representation of the system Hamiltonian. To achieve high-fidelity ML density for complex devices with interfaces and disorder, we train an equivariant graph convolutional network to predict Δ ρ-the difference between DFT and atomic superposition densities-under a charge neutrality constraint required for inhomogeneous systems. A secondary ML residual charge model compensates for errors in the primary Δ ρ model. The predicted density is then used within the full-relativistic FP-TB-MTO framework combined with the non-equilibrium Green's function method. We validate our method on bulk HgCdTe disordered alloys (including vacancy defects) and Au/HgCdTe/Au disordered devices. The maximum band energy error is below 10 meV for bulk HgCdTe. For devices, the charge neutrality constraint suppresses long-wavelength charge bias that would otherwise distort the electrostatic potential by 0.68-1.88 eV near the device center, while residual compensation corrects the remaining 0.16-0.46 eV potential mismatch, essential for reproducing the correct potential barrier profile. Together, these corrections reproduce the layer-resolved potential, including interface steps and bulk-like plateaus, within 0.1 eV of fully self-consistent DFT. Finally, we demonstrate quantum transport in a 11220-atom infrared detector. By combining first-principles accuracy with linear-scaling inference, DeltaChargeNet enables large-scale device simulations without the full DFT self-consistent field loop.

title: A hierarchical adaptive Fourier-feature physics-informed neural network for radio-frequency capacitively coupled plasma discharges
title_zh: 用于射频电容耦合等离子体放电的分层自适应傅里叶特征物理通知神经网络
summary: 物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 很难针对射频电容耦合等离子体流体泊松系统进行训练，因为缺少初始条件、陡峭的鞘层梯度和强烈不平衡的残差可能会导致不稳定或非唯一的重建。我们为此类耦合等离子体模型提出了分层自适应傅里叶特征 PINN (HA-FPINN)。该方法结合了傅里叶特征映射来改进小尺度鞘结构的表示，稀疏物理锚提供内部约束，以及两级自适应加权方案来平衡偏微分方程、边界和锚损失以及单个方程残差。该框架在 8 方程氦放电模型和 23 方程负电模型上进行了测试。
abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are difficult to train for radio-frequency capacitively coupled plasma fluid-Poisson systems because missing initial conditions, steep sheath gradients, and strongly imbalanced residuals can lead to unstable or nonunique reconstructions. We propose a Hierarchical Adaptive Fourier-feature PINN (HA-FPINN) for such coupled plasma models. The method combines Fourier feature mapping to improve the representation of small-scale sheath structures, sparse physical anchors to provide interior constraints, and a two-level adaptive weighting scheme to balance the PDE, boundary, and anchor losses as well as individual equation residuals. The framework is tested on an 8-equation helium discharge model and a 23-equation electronegative model. In the helium case, HA-FPINN reconstructs the space-time evolution of the main physical variables with anchors and converges for all tested network architectures, with convergence times of – s. In the case, HA-FPINN achieves stable reconstruction with anchors, whereas the non-adaptive FPINN and standard PINN fail to converge under the same setting. The best performance in both systems is obtained at the tested Fourier frequency parameter . Noise-injection tests show that HA-FPINN maintains the lowest reconstruction error in the helium case and preserves the main space-time structures in the case at anchor noise levels of up to . These results show that HA-FPINN provides a robust PINN formulation for strongly coupled plasma fluid models with missing initial conditions.

title: Validating Graph Neural Network Feature Attribution Through Local Perturbations: A Study on CoMoFeNiCu Decomposition Enthalpy
title_zh: 通过局部扰动验证图神经网络特征归因：CoMoFeNiCu 分解焓的研究
summary: 图神经网络（GNN）显示出预测材料特性的前景，但可解释性仍然是一个挑战，特别是理解归因特征重要性是否反映了物理现实或统计伪影。在这里，我们提出了一种方法验证研究，该研究故意过度拟合物理感知的 GNN 集合，以探讨特征排序方法的稳健性。使用具有三种化学计量的 CoMoFeNiCu 高熵合金系统，我们训练 GNN 来预测 DFT 计算结构的分解焓，同时显式约束输出权重以编码特征重要性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.18430v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) show promise for predicting materials properties, but interpretability remains a challenge, particularly understanding whether attributed feature importance reflects physical reality or statistical artifacts. Here, we present a methods validation study that deliberately overfits a physics-aware GNN ensemble to probe the robustness of feature-ranking approaches. Using the CoMoFeNiCu high-entropy alloy system with three stoichiometries, we train GNNs to predict decomposition enthalpies from DFT-calculated structures while explicitly constraining output weights to encode feature importance. By design, our dataset is limited (approximately 900 binary and 4,500 ternary decomposition pathways) to control compositional complexity and enable precise interrogation of local chemistry effects. We validate that feature rankings capture meaningful local-environment information through a series of atomic swap perturbations: perturbing individual atomic sites and re-ranking features reveals spatial decay consistent with the GNN's interaction cutoff, confirming that weights encode neighbor-shell effects rather than global stoichiometric artifacts alone. Results demonstrate that feature attribution methods can remain physically interpretable even under overfitting, provided validation is rigorous. This work establishes a foundation for trustworthy interpretability in materials GNNs and sets the stage for scaling to multiple chemistries and testing generalization across compositional spaces.

title: Machine learning of strength surfaces enables high regularization length phase-field fracture
title_zh: 强度表面的机器学习可实现高正则化长度相场断裂
summary: 脆性断裂的经典相场模型捕获了韧性控制的裂纹扩展，但没有捕获控制裂纹形核的材料强度表面。 Kumar 等人的理论。 (2020) 通过成核驱动力合并强度表面，Chockalingam (2025) 导出了由 n 个材料参数描述的任意强度表面的驱动力，其中相场强度表面 (PFSS) 以正则化长度 ε → 0 收敛到材料强度表面，并在任何 ε 的 n 个选定状态下精确匹配。
abstract: arXiv:2611.18473v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Classical phase-field models of brittle fracture capture toughness-controlled crack growth but not the material's strength surface, which governs crack nucleation. The theory of Kumar et al. (2020) incorporates the strength surface through a nucleation driving force, and Chockalingam (2025) derived this driving force for arbitrary strength surfaces described by n material parameters, with which the phase-field strength surface (PFSS) converges to the material strength surface as the regularization length ε → 0 and matches it exactly at n chosen states for any ε. In practice, however, the strength surface must be supplied as an analytic form chosen and calibrated case by case, and for the widely used analytic surfaces (n=2) accurate strength reproduction requires ε commensurate with the Irwin characteristic length lcₕ, imposing prohibitive mesh requirements for large structures. We introduce a neural-network (NN) strength function that is learned directly from strength data, is physics-constrained by construction, and provides far more calibration parameters than analytic surfaces; the calibration is generalized to any number of strength states and to enforce openness in chosen directions. A single architecture captures synthetic data from the Mohr-Coulomb, Drucker-Prager, Mogi-Coulomb and 3D Hoek-Brown surfaces and experimental data for graphite, natural rubber and styrene-butadiene rubber. The resulting PFSS is accurate up to ε = 10,lcₕ, whereas that of the exact analytic surfaces performs comparatively poorly even at ε = 0.5,lcₕ. Finite-element simulations validate the theory across fracture regimes. By decoupling strength fidelity from the regularization length, the approach substantially reduces the mesh resolution required for phase-field fracture simulations of large structures.

title: From spectra to performance: Multimodal machine learning for organic optoelectronic materials discovery
title_zh: 从光谱到性能：用于有机光电材料发现的多模态机器学习
summary: 光电材料的发现和合理优化越来越依赖于编码结构、形态、电子态和器件性能的异质表征数据。传统的光谱解释仍然依赖于专家，并且通常单独对待每种模态，限制了信息提取。机器学习改进了从单个光谱模态中提取信息的方法，但单一模态方法通常会受到不完整的结构和物理表示的影响。多模态机器学习能够将不同的光谱信号集成到统一的表示中。在这篇综述中，我们总结了光电材料中光谱-结构-性能关系的多模态光谱学习和异构数据融合的最新进展。
abstract: The discovery and rational optimization of optoelectronic materials increasingly rely on heterogeneous characterization data encoding structure, morphology, electronic states, and device properties. Conventional spectral interpretation remains expert-dependent and often treats each modality in isolation, limiting information extraction. Machine learning has improved information extraction from individual spectroscopic modalities, yet single modality approaches often suffer from incomplete structural and physical representations. Multimodal machine learning enables integration of diverse spectroscopic signals into unified representations. In this review, we summarize recent advances in multimodal spectral learning and heterogeneous data fusion for spectra–structure–property relationships in optoelectronic materials. We discuss how the synergistic combination of infrared, Raman, nuclear magnetic resonance, and mass spectrometry improves functional-group recognition, substructure inference, and spectrum-based molecular structure elucidation and raw-spectrum learning for molecular elucidation. We further elaborate on how the fusion of optical spectra, morphology, processing parameters, and molecular representations facilitates quantitative property prediction and materials discovery. Key challenges include simulation-experiment domain gaps, limited multimodal datasets, missing modalities, and insufficient model interpretability. Overall, multimodal spectral learning is emerging as a promising approach for transforming characterization from a descriptive tool into a predictive framework for rational materials design.
journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

title: Enhanced Hyperspectral Nano-FTIR Imaging by Neural-Network-Based Processing of Multiple Signal Harmonics
title_zh: 通过基于神经网络的多信号谐波处理增强超光谱纳米FTIR成像
summary: 纳米 FTIR 光谱将红外光谱与纳米级空间分辨率相结合，实现高光谱纳米成像。然而，定量测量通常依赖于高次谐波近场信号，这些信号基本上没有背景，但信噪比 (SNR) 较低。较低的谐波可提供更高的信噪比，但包含显着的背景影响，会扭曲近场响应并阻碍定量分析。在这里，我们引入了一种交叉谐波神经网络（CHNN），它利用多个谐波通道中编码的互补信息来对三次谐波高光谱数据进行去噪。 CHNN 直接在实验纳米 FTIR 数据集上进行训练，使用一次和二次谐波光谱来提高三次谐波响应的 SNR。
abstract: arXiv:2611.18387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nano-FTIR spectroscopy combines infrared spectroscopy with nanometer-scale spatial resolution and enables hyperspectral nanoimaging. However, quantitative measurements typically rely on higher-harmonic near-field signals, which are largely background-free but suffer from low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Lower harmonics provide substantially higher SNR but contain significant background contributions that distort the near-field response and hinder quantitative analysis. Here, we introduce a cross-harmonic neural network (CHNN) that exploits the complementary information encoded in multiple harmonic channels to denoise third-harmonic hyperspectral data. Trained directly on experimental nano-FTIR datasets, the CHNN uses first- and second-harmonic spectra to improve the SNR of the third-harmonic response. Applied to a PMMA/PS polymer blend, it substantially reduces noise while preserving spectral features and nanoscale spatial contrast. Compared with conventional single-harmonic denoising using an autoencoder, the CHNN achieves superior noise suppression. These results demonstrate the potential of lower-harmonic signals for improving hyperspectral nano-FTIR imaging without increasing acquisition time.

title: Fine-tuned atomistic foundation model for accurate sodium-carbon chemistry in Na-ion batteries
title_zh: 用于钠离子电池中精确钠碳化学的微调原子基础模型
summary: 原子基础模型已成为复杂化学环境下材料模拟的 DFT 级精度的有前途的途径。然而，它们在竞争键合体系中的可靠性，以及更重要的是，复杂键合如何影响材料性能的预测仍不清楚。在具有竞争键合机制的材料中，硬碳中的钠存储提出了重大挑战。硬碳具有多种局部结构图案，包括有缺陷和弯曲的石墨区域、无定形区域和闭孔/开孔。由于其对钠离子电池的重要性，我们基于不同局部 Na/C 主题的 MACE 架构系统地评估了现有的预训练基础模型。
abstract: arXiv:2611.18490v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Atomistic foundation models have emerged as a promising route to DFT-level accuracy for materials simulation with complex chemical environments. However, their reliability across competing bonding regimes and, more importantly, how complex bonding affects predictions of material properties remain unclear. Among materials with competing bonding regimes, sodium storage in hard carbon poses a substantial challenge. Hard carbon features diverse local structural motifs, including defective and curved graphitic regions, amorphous regions, and closed/open pores. Motivated by its importance for Na-ion batteries, we systematically evaluate existing pretrained foundation models based on the MACE architecture across different local Na/C motifs. We find that the pretrained models fail to accurately capture Na-Na and Na-C interactions for metallic Na clusters on graphene. To recover a DFT-level energetic description, we employ targeted fine-tuning, showing that it can describe the energetic stability of local motifs and achieve sufficient transferability to unseen Na/C environments. With the developed fine-tuned model, we establish a correlation between closed-pore radius in hard carbon and plateau voltage, showing that the small pores contribute at larger voltages than large ones, suggesting thus how the developed fine-tuned foundation model can link atomistic information with materials design for complex bonding environments.

title: Diffusion Tree Sampling for Inference Time Adaptation of Crystal Generative Models
title_zh: 用于晶体生成模型推理时间自适应的扩散树采样
summary: 基于扩散的生成模型已经成为优于合理晶体结构的强大先验，但将先验转变为有希望的候选模型需要同时转向几个相互冲突的属性。微调成本高昂，并且会为每个新目标生成一个新模型，而可微分指导不适用于许多现实世界的任务。相反，我们使用扩散树采样（DTS）在推理时调整这些生成模型，这是一种针对去噪轨迹的蒙特卡洛树搜索过程。我们在 DTS 之上做出了两项与 AI 科学应用特别相关的技术贡献。
abstract: arXiv:2611.17462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion-based generative models have become strong priors over plausible crystal structures, but turning that prior into promising candidates requires steering toward several conflicting properties at once. Fine-tuning is expensive and produces a new model for every new objective, while differentiable guidance is not applicable to many real-world tasks. We instead adapt these generative models at inference time using Diffusion Tree Sampling (DTS), a Monte Carlo tree search procedure over the denoising trajectory. We make two technical contributions on top of DTS that are particularly relevant for AI-for-science applications. First, we show how to use existing property-conditional generative models (e.g., models fine-tuned for classifier-free guidance) as guided proposals inside DTS, without distorting the target distribution. Second, we extend DTS to multi-objective sampling, so that a single search produces samples spanning an entire Pareto front. We instantiate both adaptations on de novo crystal generation: improving the stability of crystals generated by different models, using pretrained conditional models to generate crystals belonging to rare space groups or with high bulk modulus, and generating crystals along a Pareto front of high dielectric constant and high bandgap materials. Across these tasks, DTS-based inference-time adaptation successfully improves model outputs without modifying the models themselves.

title: Bridging surface dynamics and phase transitions in CsPbI₃ perovskite with machine-learning force fields and dispersion interactions
title_zh: 通过机器学习力场和色散相互作用桥接 CsPbI₃ 钙钛矿的表面动力学和相变
summary: 作者：Iryna Knysh、Anton Charkin-Gorbulin、Claudio Quarti、David Beljonne、Igor Poltavsky 和 Alexandre Tkatchenko 在表面平板上训练的机器学习模型能否准确描述体相变？作者通过在立方 CsPbI 3 板配置上训练的模型证明了这一点，该模型重现了块状 CsPbI 3 中温度驱动的正交-四方-立方相变。作者表明，成对和超成对分散处理之间的选择会显着影响预测的相变。
abstract: Author(s): Iryna Knysh, Anton Charkin-Gorbulin, Claudio Quarti, David Beljonne, Igor Poltavsky, and Alexandre Tkatchenko Can a machine learning model trained on surface slabs accurately describe bulk phase transitions? The authors demonstrate this with a model trained on cubic CsPbI 3 slab configurations that reproduces the temperature-driven orthorhombic-tetragonal-cubic phase transitions in bulk CsPbI 3 . The authors show that the choice between pairwise and beyond-pairwise dispersion treatments significantly affects the predicted phase transitions. The authors attribute these differences to the strong sensitivity of Cs and I atomic forces to the treatment of van der Waals dispersion. Their findings highlight the potential of surface-trained machine learning models for transferable atomistic simulations and the crucial role of dispersion interactions in perovskite dynamics. [Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 113802] Published Mon Nov 16, 2026

title: AI for Parameter Selection in Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization
title_zh: 基于样本的量子对角化中参数选择的人工智能
summary: 基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）方法提供了一种计算分子基态能量的方法，但其准确性和运行时间敏感地取决于配置选择，例如子空间维度、传播时间步长以及跨电路的固定采样预算分配，而对于这些配置选择不存在正式的选择方法。在这项工作中，我们探索预言模型是否可以根据哈密顿量和候选配置预测量子运行时间和近似误差。
abstract: arXiv:2611.18307v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) methods provide a way to compute molecular ground-state energies, but their accuracy and runtime depend sensitively on configuration choices such as the subspace dimension, propagation timestep, and the allocation of a fixed sampling budget across circuits, for which no formal selection method exists. In this work, we explore whether oracle models can predict the quantum runtime and approximation error from the Hamiltonian and the candidate configuration. Using synthetic Hamiltonians with controllable spectral properties, we show that machine-learned models can map a Hamiltonian directly to the best-ranked configuration within a predefined grid for the SKQD algorithm, validated against classical Krylov propagation, achieving strong rank correlations between true and predicted error and runtime, Spearman ρ = 0.969 and ρ = 0.905, respectively. Extending the approach to 50 molecular Hamiltonians (20-50 qubits), with reference ground-state energies from classical calculations, we train regressors that predict the simulation error and runtime for a given molecule--configuration pair ahead of execution, and classifiers to distinguish, from 600 SqDRIFT quantum-hardware runs, whether a configuration achieves a ground-state energy within chemical accuracy (1.6×10⁻³ Ha approx 1 kcal/mol). For the molecular Hamiltonians, the models additionally provide an a priori feasibility and resource estimate, predicting whether a molecule can reach chemical accuracy on current hardware and at what runtime, thus correctly classifying held-out molecules at the molecule level, achieving balanced accuracy 61.8% in-distribution and 100% for five larger held-out molecules.

title: Regularized Neural Quantum States for Heisenberg Magnets
title_zh: 海森堡磁体的正则化神经量子态
summary: 我们介绍了一种使用神经网络量子态求解局部有序量子自旋系统的方法。首先，我们的方法依赖于选择由经典或量子参考态的磁性纹理构造的自旋基础。其次，该方法通过适应变分状态流形的量子态几何的正则黎曼梯度下降来提高收敛性并抑制参数空间漂移。结合这些技术，可以对具有 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用的二维和三维手性自旋系统进行稳定的基态计算。由此产生的变分基态能量与高保真密度矩阵重整化群计算的那些具有竞争力，并且对于周期性和层状几何形状，提供了显着更严格的基态能量上限。
abstract: arXiv:2611.18497v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce an approach to solving locally ordered quantum spin systems using neural network quantum states. First, our approach rests on choosing a spin basis constructed from the magnetic texture of a classical or quantum reference state. Second, the method improves convergence and suppresses parameter-space drift through a regularized Riemannian gradient descent adapted to the quantum state geometry of the variational state manifold. Combining these techniques enables stable ground-state calculations for two- and three-dimensional chiral spin systems with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions. The resulting variational ground-state energies are competitive with those of high-fidelity density matrix renormalization group calculations and, for periodic and layered geometries, provide significantly tighter upper bounds on the ground-state energy.

title: Foundation Tensor Networks Generalize Across Quantum Lattice Systems
title_zh: 基础张量网络在量子晶格系统中推广
summary: 神经量子态和张量网络已成为模拟量子多体系统的领先技术。然而，无序系统在这两个框架中仍然极具挑战性，因为它们需要为无序的每次实现计算基态。最近，神经量子态已被用来构建直接从哈密顿量生成基态的基础模型。尽管如此，他们仍然受到需要进行大量采样来估计可观测值的阻碍。为了解决这些困难，我们引入了基础张量网络（FTN），它使用神经网络从哈密顿量生成基态波函数的张量网络表示。
abstract: arXiv:2611.17655v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural quantum states and tensor networks have emerged as leading techniques for simulating quantum many-body systems. However, disordered systems remain extremely challenging in both frameworks as they require computation of the ground state for every realization of the disorder. Recently, neural quantum states have been used to construct foundation models that generate the ground state directly from the Hamiltonian. Still, they are hindered by the need to perform extensive sampling to estimate observables. To address these difficulties, we introduce the foundation tensor network (FTN), which uses a neural network to generate the tensor network representation of the ground-state wavefunction from the Hamiltonian. To accelerate training, we develop a technique, called textttGridBP, based on iterated one-dimensional belief propagation that reduces the cost of computing the energy expectation value to just two tensor contractions. We use FTNs to calculate the critical parameters of the glass transition in the quantum Edwards-Anderson model via finite-size scaling analysis. To facilitate rapid averaging, we use a moment-generating function to evaluate the order parameter, lowering the cost to a single tensor contraction. We obtain high-fidelity estimates for the critical parameters by averaging over 500,000 disorder realizations.

title: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
title_zh: 可验证的 pXRD：使用 LLM 试剂进行爬山式 pXRD 结构测定
summary: 通过粉末 X 射线衍射 (pXRD) 自主确定晶体结构仍然是自驱动材料实验室的一个关键瓶颈。我们将 pXRD 结构确定的任务制定为可验证的代理搜索问题：可以在推理过程中通过正向模拟轮廓一致性来评估候选结构，并在评估过程中通过与已知参考的结构匹配来评估候选结构。为了衡量进展情况，我们引入了 pXRD-Bench，这是一套包含 200 个模拟单相问题的套件，涵盖分布结构确定、具有挑战性的多态结构以及受控的成分和拓扑分布变化。
abstract: arXiv:2611.17539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous crystal-structure determination from powder X-ray diffraction (pXRD) remains a key bottleneck for self-driving materials laboratories. We formulate the task of pXRD structure determination as a verifiable agentic search problem: candidate structures can be assessed during inference through forward-simulated profile agreement and during evaluation through structural matching to a known reference. To benchmark progress, we introduce pXRD-Bench, a suite of 200 simulated single-phase problems spanning in-distribution structure determination, challenging and polymorphic structures, and controlled compositional and topological distribution shifts. Agent adaptation raises selected structural recovery from 27% to 69%, with further gains from repeated sampling and verifier-guided inference-time scaling. We extend this approach to experimental multiphase pXRD through a reflexive evolution framework that learns from self-generated synthetic problems. A replaceable laboratory specification defines the sample family and measurement conditions. An evolver agent uses the known generating structures and measurement parameters to diagnose solver failures and develop persistent guidance and executable tools, which are then provided to agents on measured patterns. This supplies verifiable training experience without requiring a collection of solved experimental measurements. On 15 measured patterns from solid-state synthesis, the evolved package improves average profile agreement and transfers an analogue-substitution procedure that recovers a phase whose structure is absent from the supplied reference library. These results demonstrate how learning from verifiable synthetic experience can improve agentic characterization of experimental samples whose structures are not known in advance.

title: Topology-based fast neutron background suppression and sterile-neutrino sensitivity in a segmented reactor overlineνₑ detector
title_zh: 分段反应堆上线νₑ探测器中基于拓扑的快中子背景抑制和惰性中微子灵敏度
summary: 反应堆电子反中微子通常通过逆β衰变相互作用来检测，先是瞬发正电子，然后是延迟中子俘获。在浅层或地上分段有机闪烁体探测器中，相关快中子是主要背景，因为质子反冲可以模拟瞬发 IBD 信号。我们使用用于反应堆反中微子探测器的印度闪烁体矩阵作为案例研究来研究基于拓扑的机器学习。多层感知器根据详细的 Geant4 模拟重建的拓扑可观测量进行训练。 mathrmF₁ 分数和独立验证样本上的 bootstrap 重采样产生 PIBD>0.40 的固定阈值。
abstract: arXiv:2611.17348v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reactor electron antineutrinos are commonly detected through the inverse beta decay interaction, with a prompt positron followed by delayed neutron capture. In shallow or above-ground segmented organic scintillator detectors, correlated fast neutrons are a dominant background because proton recoils can mimic the prompt IBD signal. We study topology-based machine learning using the Indian Scintillator Matrix for Reactor Anti-Neutrinos detector as a case study. A multilayer perceptron is trained on reconstructed topological observables from detailed Geant4 simulations. The mathrmF₁ score and bootstrap resampling on an independent validation sample yield a fixed threshold of PIBD>0.40. Applied without further optimization to an independent testing sample, the MLP retains (83.4± 0.7)% of IBD events and rejects (77.3± 0.7)% of fast neutron events. In a controlled spectral benchmark using an independent AmBe fast neutron spectrum, the selection reduces the net candidate-spectrum deformation by 84%. The energy dependent signal acceptance and residual fast neutron component are subsequently incorporated into a binned likelihood, which recovers the injected IBD signal strength as mathrmhatα=0.993⁺⁰.⁰⁵³₋₀.₀₄₈, with an empirical goodness-of-fit probability of 0.434. The expected sterile-neutrino sensitivity for the ISMRAN detector is evaluated at baselines of 13 m and 18 m, with two years of exposure at each baseline. For the nominal pre-MLP S/B=1:2 benchmark and the background model, retaining the classifier score in a joint (mathrmEₚᵣₒₘₚₜ× PIBD) likelihood improves the 95% C.L. sensitivity to sin²2θ₁₄ by a logarithmically averaged 7.9% over 0.1≤Δ m₄₁²≤1~eV² relative to an energy-only likelihood with the same fast neutron contamination.

title: Pressure and Magnetic Field Control of Topology in Antiferromagnetic Bilayers
title_zh: 反铁磁双层拓扑的压力和磁场控制
summary: 控制磁性半导体中的能带拓扑需要将电子结构与实验上可达到的自由度耦合的策略。在这里，我们提出了一种基于 A 型反铁磁双层中的压力和磁重定向的协作方法。反平行层磁化强度抑制了交换极化带边态之间的杂化，限制了它们对层间压缩的响应。对齐层矩的磁场消除了这种自旋失配，从而使压力增强杂交能够驱动能带反转。然后，磁化方向控制反转能带的对称性，以及自旋轨道耦合是否产生陈绝缘间隙或对称保护的节点交叉。双层 CrSBr 的第一性原理计算说明了压缩正交结构模型中的这种机制。
abstract: arXiv:2611.18525v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling band topology in magnetic semiconductors requires strategies that couple electronic structure to experimentally accessible degrees of freedom. Here we propose a cooperative approach based on pressure and magnetic reorientation in A-type antiferromagnetic bilayers. Antiparallel layer magnetizations suppress hybridization between exchange-polarized band-edge states, limiting their response to interlayer compression. A magnetic field that aligns the layer moments removes this spin mismatch, enabling pressure-enhanced hybridization to drive a band inversion. The magnetization direction then controls the symmetries of the inverted bands and whether spin--orbit coupling produces a Chern-insulating gap or symmetry-protected nodal crossings. First-principles calculations for bilayer CrSBr illustrate this mechanism within a compressed orthorhombic structural model. Out-of-plane magnetization yields a Chern insulator with a chiral edge state, whereas in-plane magnetization supports a two-dimensional Weyl semimetal with node-connecting edge states. Continuous spin canting further demonstrates how magnetic reorientation can drive the transition and stabilize the Chern phase before full magnetic saturation. Although material-specific transition conditions depend on electronic correlations and structural stability under compression, the underlying strategy identifies interlayer hybridization as a link between magnetic order and band topology. These results provide a design principle for externally tunable topological phases in layered antiferromagnetic semiconductors.

title: Fibonacci Non-Abelian Quantum Hall States with Pair Structure - a classification of chiral 2-cluster many-body wave-functions
title_zh: 具有对结构的斐波那契非阿贝尔量子霍尔态 - 手性 2 簇多体波函数的分类
summary: 斐波那契任意子支持通用拓扑量子计算。它们被提议出现在分数量子霍尔 (FQH) 系统中，例如有效 SU(3)2 Chern-Simons 理论描述的填充分数 ν=tfrac23 态，以及具有 3 团簇结构的 ν=tfrac25 态（n 团簇结构意味着 n 电子束缚态形成以下形式的 Laughlin 型波函数） (z⁽ⁿ⁾ᵢ-z⁽ⁿ⁾ⱼ)^m)。
abstract: arXiv:2611.18521v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fibonacci anyons support universal topological quantum computation. They have been proposed to emerge in fractional quantum Hall (FQH) systems, such as the filling-fraction ν=tfrac23 state described by an effective SU(3)₂ Chern-Simons theory, and the ν=tfrac25 state with a 3-cluster structure (an n-cluster structure means that n-electron bound states form a Laughlin-type wave function of the form (z⁽ⁿ⁾ᵢ-z⁽ⁿ⁾ⱼ)^m). In this work, we systematically classify FQH wave functions P(z₁,ldots,z_N) in the N→infty limit, through a generalized pattern of zeros (gPOZ) approach, where the wave function is determined by the leading order of zero along with the accompanying leading polynomial that develops as successive number of zᵢ's are brought together. Within this approach, we obtain a (ν,h,c)-classification of wave functions with a 2-cluster (pair) structure. Among these wave functions, those with (h,c) = (tfrac12,tfrac12), (tfrac32,tfrac710), (3,tfrac45) correspond to gapped FQH states with filling fraction ν and edge-state chiral central charge c+1, while others with c<0 may be gapless. We find that even a 2-cluster structure can give rise to Fibonacci statistics, for (ν,h,c) = (tfrac14,tfrac32,tfrac710), corresponding to the (5,4) minimal model, and for (ν,h,c) = (tfrac17,3,tfrac45), corresponding to the (6,5) minimal model. We further construct an ideal 4-body Hamiltonian whose ground state is the (tfrac14,tfrac32,tfrac710) state.

title: Local gluing classification and bulk-locked clock rings for Z_N models on a Klein bottle
title_zh: 克莱因瓶上 Z_N 模型的局部粘合分类和批量锁定时钟环
summary: 我们对格子克莱因瓶上的 Z_N 板模型的局部反射粘合进行分类，并解决了受阻的文字接缝。在单项式远角 ansatz 中，所有通勤粘合形成一个由 Z_N 单位 u 标记的族。它们对于每个 N 在偶数接缝长度上都存在，并且在奇数长度上，恰好当 -1 是模 N 的平方时存在。我们确定了任意子输运，包括与 P²=C 进行电荷共轭 C 的交换接缝，以及区分未受挫码与通勤但受挫哈密顿量的关系相。对于字面粘合，2Lₓ非通勤小板形成自双时钟环，其扇区被块体锁定。
abstract: arXiv:2611.17816v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We classify local reflection gluings of the Z_N plaquette model on lattice Klein bottles and solve the obstructed literal seam. Within the monomial far-corner ansatz, all commuting gluings form a family labelled by a unit u of Z_N. They exist for every N at even seam length and, at odd length, exactly when -1 is a square modulo N. We determine the anyon transport, including exchange seams with P²=C for charge conjugation C, and the relation phases that distinguish an unfrustrated code from a commuting but frustrated Hamiltonian. For the literal gluing, the 2Lₓ noncommuting plaquettes form self-dual clock rings whose sectors are locked by the bulk. This gives an exact reduction of the spectrum to clock-ring spectra, closed-form ring ground energies for N=2,4, and a closed-form ground-state degeneracy. We further determine twisted-coefficient homology on the stated surface domains and compare it with logical modules on registered lattice grids; composite dimensions need not give squares of cyclic groups. Dressed-isometry gates and monodromy are reported with their finite-grid scope. Finally, the qudit Gottesman--Knill theorem bounds the computational interpretation: Clifford deformations and Weyl measurements with stabilizer inputs and no external magic states cannot supply a non-stabilizer resource. Charge-conjugation measurements that do supply such states lie outside this operation model. The new results concern explicit seam classification, phase-sensitive consistency and bulk-locked spectra, not a new general no-go theorem or a universal computing architecture.

title: Theoretical exploration of ambient-pressure superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate: A strategy of atomic substitution for tuning chemical pressure
title_zh: 双层镍酸盐环境压力超导性的理论探索：原子替代调节化学压力的策略
summary: 通过化学取代从理论上探讨了 La₃Ni2O₇ 中常压超导的可能性。利用第一性原理和多体计算，我们建议在镧系元素位点取代Ba以施加化学压力，从而减轻抑制超导性的八面体畸变。声子计算证明了 mathrmLa₃₋ᵢₜₓBaᵢₜₓNi2O₇ 中高对称性四方相在 x sim 0.15 的小掺杂比下的动态稳定性。通过将波动交换近似应用于从该稳定结构导出的有效模型哈密顿量，我们计算了 Eliashberg 特征值 λ，以评估现有非常规超导体的相对超导转变温度 T_c。
abstract: arXiv:2611.17709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The possibility of ambient-pressure superconductivity in La₃Ni₂O₇ is theoretically explored via chemical substitution. Using first-principles and many-body calculations, we propose substituting Ba at the lanthanide site to exert chemical pressure, thereby mitigating the octahedral distortions that suppress superconductivity. Phonon calculations demonstrate the dynamical stability of the high-symmetry tetragonal phase in mathrmLa₃₋ᵢₜₓBaᵢₜₓNi₂O₇ at a small doping ratio of x sim 0.15. By applying the fluctuation exchange approximation to an effective model Hamiltonian derived from this stable structure, we calculate the Eliashberg eigenvalue λ to evaluate the relative superconducting transition temperature T_c to existing unconventional superconductors. We conclude that s_±-wave superconductivity is likely to emerge, as the required Ba concentration (x sim 0.15) is sufficiently small to minimize the detrimental suppression of superconductivity induced by hole doping.

title: Transfer-Matrix Calculus for Infinite Matrix Product States
title_zh: 无限矩阵乘积状态的传递矩阵微积分
summary: 长程相互作用，从电子之间的库仑斥力到捕获离子和里德伯原子的幂律相互作用，在量子多体物理学中广泛存在。然而，对于无限系统，MPS 算法（一维的标准经典参考）通常依赖于计算折衷：用指数拟合和替换这些相互作用。我们开发了传递矩阵微积分 (TMC)，这是一个用于推导无限 MPS 算法的统一框架。在 TMC 中，相互作用被写为传递矩阵的函数，然后一组收缩规则产生 DMRG 和 VUMPS 的有效哈密顿量、切线空间激励作用和能量方差，而无需 MPO。
abstract: arXiv:2611.18427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-range interactions, from the Coulomb repulsion between electrons to the power-law interactions of trapped ions and Rydberg atoms, are widespread in quantum many-body physics. For infinite systems, however, MPS algorithms, the standard classical reference in one dimension, conventionally rely on a computational compromise: replacing these interactions by fitted sums of exponentials. We develop transfer-matrix calculus (TMC), a unified framework for deriving infinite-MPS algorithms. In TMC, an interaction is written as a function of the transfer matrix, and one set of contraction rules then yields the effective Hamiltonians of DMRG and VUMPS, the tangent-space excitation action, and the energy variance, without an MPO. Long-range interactions thus enter with their prescribed distance dependence. For the half-filled lattice Coulomb chain with a 1/d interaction of strength V, theory predicts CDW order for all V>0, but at weak coupling this order is too weak for earlier numerics to resolve. Using TMC, we obtain infinite-MPS ground states at V=2 directly in the thermodynamic limit, with an energy variance per site of 2×10⁻¹⁰. Our data, extrapolated to zero energy variance, indicate a small nonzero CDW amplitude, m₀=0.002213(14), consistent with this prediction. The complete V=2 optimization workflow across the full series of bond dimensions takes less than a day on a single AMD MI250X GPU die. For an exactly solvable long-range hopping model, TMC reproduces the nonanalytic |k| cusp of the one-particle dispersion that any fixed finite sum of decaying exponentials rounds off. We also use TMC to optimize first-quantized MPS directly in the thermodynamic limit. For half-filled free fermions, our entanglement entropy data show scaling consistent with central charge c=1 over the studied bond dimensions, as for second-quantized MPS.

title: Quantitative Impact of Occupation Smearing Methods on Conventional Superconductivity: from Electronic Structure through Lattice Dynamics to Electron-Phonon Coupling
title_zh: 职业涂抹方法对传统超导性的定量影响：从电子结构到晶格动力学再到电子声子耦合
summary: 在金属系统的第一性原理计算中，布里渊区的离散电子网格需要涂抹函数及其宽度（例如广泛使用的 0.02 Ry Methfessel-Paxton 方案），以增强费米表面能量和占据的连续性。然而，这些经验参数对声子介导的超导性的定量影响长期以来一直被忽视，导致人们习惯性地根据惯例选择它们。在这里，我们以六氢化CsH6为基准，系统地研究了无参数优化四面体方法中涂抹引起的误差的大小和传播机制。
abstract: arXiv:2610.18185v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In first-principles calculations of metallic systems, the discrete electronic mesh in the Brillouin zone necessitates a smearing function and its width (e.g., the widely used 0.02 Ry Methfessel-Paxton scheme) to enforce continuity of energy and occupation at the Fermi surface. However, the quantitative impact of such empirical parameters on phonon-mediated superconductivity has long been overlooked, leading to their habitual selection by mere convention. Here, using hexahydride CsH6 as a benchmark, we systematically investigate the magnitude and propagation mechanism of smearing-induced errors against the parameter-free optimized tetrahedron method. Long-tailed smearing delocalizes the occupation window, causing substantial Fermi-level shifts, flattening of the density of states, and hardening phonon modes, thereby weakening electron-phonon coupling. Conversely, short-tailed smearing suffers from insufficient sampling, producing density-of-states oscillations and enhanced Fermi-surface nesting. These artifacts amplify electronic screening and Peierls instabilities, which soften acoustic modes and generate imaginary frequencies, causing CsH6 to be dynamically unstable and discarded. However, the optimized tetrahedron method reveals that CsH6 is dynamically stable under ambient pressure with a remarkable superconducting transition temperature of 121 K. To prevent subjective empirical parameters from obscuring theoretically promising high-temperature superconductors, we derive a simple scaling relation for the smearing width, applicable to different smearing functions, from the free-electron-gas model, offering an objective, precise, and efficient protocol for parameter selection in high-throughput screening.

title: Composition Driven Band Alignment Evolution in Grafted Si/GeSn Heterostructures
title_zh: 接枝 Si/GeSn 异质结构中成分驱动的能带排列演化
summary: 了解和控制基于晶格失配的 IV 族半导体异质结构中的能带排列是合理能带结构工程的基础，因为它控制着异质集成半导体系统中的电子结构和载流子传输。尽管人们对 Si/GeSn 异质结构的兴趣日益浓厚，但与成分相关的能带排列尚未通过实验建立。在这里，我们使用 X 射线光电子能谱和 Kraut 核心级方法实验建立了含量范围为 8.8% 至 12.4% 的半导体接枝 Si/GeSn 异质结构中能带排列的演变。
abstract: arXiv:2611.17453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding and controlling band alignment in lattice-mismatched group-IV semiconductor-based heterostructures is fundamental to rational band-structure engineering, as it governs the electronic structure and carrier transport in heterointegrated semiconductor systems. Despite growing interest in Si/GeSn heterostructures, the composition-dependent band alignment has not been experimentally established. Here, we experimentally establish the evolution of band alignment in semiconductor-grafted Si/GeSn heterostructures with contents ranging from 8.8% to 12.4% using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy and Kraut's core-level method. The valence-band offset increases systematically from ~0.29 to ~0.57 eV with increasing Sn composition, whereas the corresponding effective conduction-band offset decreases from ~0.30 to ~0.12 eV. The observed band-alignment evolution is attributed to an upward shift of the GeSn valence-band maximum arising from enhanced p-p orbital hybridization, reduced bonding-antibonding splitting, and compressive-strain-induced heavy-hole band lifting. These findings establish the experimental relationship between alloy composition and interfacial band alignment in semiconductor-grafted Si/GeSn heterostructures, providing a quantitative framework for rational band-structure engineering in lattice-mismatched group-IV semiconductor heterostructures.
